review_description: We recently had our solar panels installed by Julian. He did a very good job. He was honest in his quotation and the installation went off without a hitch. Everything was done well and professionally. No question went unanswered and he patiently explained how things work to us. Thanks, Julian.Will definitely recommend him for any future jobs.
They gave a quality service, very organized, they helped me with all the doubts, the best ones

Installation was completed efficiently with minimal disruption to our daily routine.What impressed us most:•	Clear communication and realistic timelines•	Clean, quality workmanship•	System performing exactly as promised•	Competitive pricing with excellent valueAlready seeing significant savings on our electricity bills. The team left our property spotless and took time to explain the system operation.Highly recommend Jenergy for anyone considering solar. Professional, reliable, and delivers on their promises.

I'm old now and have met many people during my time. It's hard to find trustworthy people like Julian nowadays. He is the type of person I would leave the house keys with and have no worries. He guided us during the whole process and handled everything. Hardly lifted a finger myself. His team also helped us remove our old solar system, and the birds nests and leaves that were under it. Took photos with his drone for us after the installation was completed. Explained the next steps and how the solar app works. Fantastic installation and I would recommend Jenergy any day of the week. We also had an issue with our garage power(unrelated to solar) later on and Julian came out to fix it that very day. Thanks again mate, best of luck.
